name: TC-129: changing the range to Last 7 days reloads the dashboard
description: Selecting the 'Last 7 days' preset and applying it re-fetches the dashboard for the new window: the request fires, the picker closes, and the page resolves again with no load error.
descriptionHtml: Selecting the 'Last 7 days' preset and applying it re-fetches the dashboard for the new window: the request fires, the picker closes, and the page resolves again with no load error.

testStage.description: Selecting the 'Last 7 days' preset and applying it re-fetches the dashboard for the new window: the request fires, the picker closes, and the page resolves again with no load error.

steps.name: Wait for selector getByRole('heading', { name: 'Restaurant Analytics' })

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('button:not([data-tour])').filter({ hasText: /^(Today|Yesterday|Last 7 days|Last 30 days|Last 90 days|This month|Last month|This year|Last year)$|\d{1,2},\s*\d{4}\s*-\s*/ })
Apply the 'Last 7 days' preset and wait for the dashboard fetch
Click locator('button:not([data-tour])').filter({ hasText: /^(Today|Yesterday|Last 7 days|Last 30 days|Last 90 days|This month|Last month|This year|Last year)$|\d{1,2},\s*\d{4}\s*-\s*/ })
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Last 7 days', exact: true })
Verify the dashboard resolved again without error
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: /Total Orders/ }).or(getByText('No analytics data for this date range')).first()
Expect "toHaveCount" getByText('Failed to load dashboard data. Please try again.')

Expect "toHaveText" locator('button:not([data-tour])').filter({ hasText: /^(Today|Yesterday|Last 7 days|Last 30 days|Last 90 days|This month|Last month|This year|Last year)$|\d{1,2},\s*\d{4}\s*-\s*/ })
